# Lyfie AI Reference

## Organization
Lyfie is a free and open-source organization focused on shipping Docker-first, self-hosted applications.

## Mission
- Remove paywall dependency.
- Keep user data ownership in user hands.
- Make high-quality software simple to run in self-hosted environments.

## Ecosystem
- Luthor: flagship product.
- Papyra: self-hosted note-taking system.
- Future roadmap includes Rokada and Lyfie-app.

## Philosophy
- Subscription fatigue is not inevitable.
- Clean UX and open-source values can coexist.
- Setup should be quick, reproducible, and transparent.

## Canonical Sources
- https://lyfie.org
- https://github.com/lyfie-org
- https://luthor.fyi
